Prior R94Q model/function and second-allele distinctions.

evidence_rows.observation: The 2024 human fibroblast and reprogrammed motor-neuron work uses 8015 mixture from one T105M patient background.

units.observations: cells with multiple mitochondria per cell

evidence_rows.decision_impact: Retain family rationale without assigning pure-P2 activity or multiple patient replication.

evidence_rows.observation: The 2020 human experiments use Chimera C across four reported patient backgrounds, with repeated neuronal conversions; the later 2022 methods explicitly identify Arg364Trp.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Broader allele context remains attached to the different compound and source lineage.

evidence_rows.observation: MShef11 hESC-derived R94Q/+ subclones are an engineered isogenic model; the corroborative patient R94Q model is reused from Van Lent 2021.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Improved model specification does not increase independent patient efficacy evidence.

evidence_rows.observation: R94Q/+ motor neurons have transport abnormalities but no overt mutant/control patch-clamp difference at days 34-36; ACY-738 provides a transport-response example.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: A normal baseline electrical endpoint cannot test electrical restoration; transport correction does not establish integrated useful output.

evidence_rows.observation: A patient-derived R94Q line shows increased network-burst rate, with reported correction in an isogenic line.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Provides a disease-associated network readout, not a validated P2 motor-unit response. Suppression of bursting alone need not be useful repair.

evidence_rows.observation: Genetic correction precedes differentiation; the paper's separate drug context also begins during differentiation and reports mitochondrial readouts.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Supports disease attribution but cannot alone qualify a strong negative inference about reversing an established motor-unit deficit.
evidence_rows.interpretation_limit: Post-deficit modifiability is not a universal prerequisite for every exploratory qualification, useful ongoing-control or preservation question.

evidence_rows.observation: The BrainXell/ANANDA platform is described as already used for CMT2A drug screening, with one R364W patient line and a healthy comparator.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: A concrete mechanistic route may reduce qualification work; it does not establish the full original informative function scope.
Replace an undifferentiated annotation uncertainty with a specific public mapping; retain lot identity and functional qualification requirements.

evidence_rows.observation: NYSCF catalog footer prints 05/15/24 and request-based distribution; prior Round 4 established that the Summer 2024 T105M table was a donor wishlist.
evidence_rows.fresh_access_limit: PDF exceeds retrieval tool size limit
evidence_rows.wishlist_fact_basis: Prior primary-PDF inspection documented in HT21-L01, not a fresh successful read of HT21-S11
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Do not infer present stock or a ready functional model from dates, mutation mentions or recruitment requests.

evidence_rows.observation: The purported human R364W MEF construct was R364T; specified figures and extrapolated human-pathogenesis and pro-fusion-harm propositions were withdrawn.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Keep R364W eligible for an allele-specific question without treating the corrected error as either a contraindication or proof of benefit.

evidence_rows.observation: Chimera improved mitochondrial morphology/polarization in four metabolically stressed CMT2A fibroblast backgrounds, including R364W; donor and investigator lineage overlaps earlier work.

units.figure_statistics: independent culture experiments; not additional donors

evidence_rows.decision_impact: Retain mechanistic plausibility and the stress condition while avoiding repeated lineage and compound substitution.

evidence_rows.observation: L248H and M376V contexts have reduced fusion frequency but opposite morphological phenotypes; L248H has a prominent fission disturbance.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Do not turn a shape category into a P2 responder/exclusion rule; useful output and actual response remain the relevant uncertainty.

evidence_rows.observation: The institutional organoid project proposes expanding a primarily CMT1A-validated platform to MFN2/GARS1 and quantitative stimulated contractility.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Treat substantial new platform construction as a different, repriced information project; do not assume the original functional tranche is immediately executable.

evidence_rows.observation: Public collaborative, created, licensed and partnered testing routes exist; current capacity, terms and exact deliverables have not been secured.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Public routes support scientific feasibility questions but cannot be priced as a complete ready human-function package without a defined deliverable. Model and compound rights remain separate.

evidence_rows.observation: Named searches and inspected primary reports did not recover a qualifying exact-P2 human functional result or treated-human cohort.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: The bridge remains open; no new exact-P2 human evidence upgrades the current claim.

evidence_rows.decision_basis: A preliminary mechanistic or model qualification action can be useful, but reduced information yield cannot inherit rank six or the original useful-function EV by retaining the old price label.

One qualified disease/control background can support exploration; broader replication belongs to broader claims. A useful direct-muscle or ongoing-control effect is not automatically a failure of the product opportunity.
